summary: Convert a project from the old file scheme to the new one
description: Renames files in the old scheme (*.asset.json) to <name>.vc<kind>, moves assets/ to graphics/ or music/, and build/assets/ to build/export/. References in sources, includes and assets are updated too. Every rename is printed. build/export/ is created again at the next build.

forms.summary: Convert a project from the old file scheme to the new one

args.name: project-folder
args.help: Root of the project. The default is the working folder.

examples.title: Convert the project in the working folder

notes: If there is nothing to convert, the output is: nothing to convert.
The command has no options. The first argument is taken as the folder.

args.name: projectfolder
args.help: Project root; default is the working folder.

options.help: Actually write the conversion; without this option it only shows what would change.

notes: Turns .include "build/export/hero.asm" into .include "graphics/hero.vcsprite" (BASIC: #include). A line with hero.anim.asm directly after it is removed: including the media file delivers data and tables together.
If a name matches no media file or several in the project, the line stays unchanged and is reported.
forms.summary: Convert old include paths build/export/… to the media file
